description: Request a structured verification report for a company in the EU/UK (registry status, address, officers where public, VAT/LEI cross-checks, red flags). Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually, with volume tiers.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

company_name.description: Legal or trading name of the company.

country.description: Country of the company (ISO code or name).

focus.description: Optional: what matters most (e.g. still active? who are the directors?).

identifiers.description: Optional: register number, VAT ID, LEI.

name: request_company_verification
title: Request a company verification report
